item.title: Staff Post - Reversion Note
item.content:encoded:
Noting a reversion made towards an edit by LofB whereby the following paragraphs were converted to bulleted list.

For non-collab articles, non-authors may only edit spelling, grammar and punctuation. For structural changes, please consult the author or staff before making those changes yourself.

+ show block
– hide block


In the first stage, SCP-269 will begin to filter contaminants and infectious agents such as blood-borne bacteria and viruses. This includes many disease agents that are currently incurable such as the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV); SCP-269 appears to be capable of identifying and isolating infected blood cells from healthy ones. As this process often results in a general improvement in the health of the host, the host may resist attempts to have SCP-269 removed. This stage typically lasts anywhere from one week to one month.

In the second stage, SCP-269 will begin filtering components of the host's immune system from the bloodstream. Because SCP-269 continues to filter infectious agents from the host's body, this generally goes unnoticed unless a blood analysis is performed. Stage 2 lasts anywhere from one month to six months.

In the final stage, SCP-269 will begin to filter vital blood components such as red blood cells and platelets, causing an onset of acute anemia and thrombocytopenia. Hosts that reach Stage 3 quickly weaken and will invariably expire within one week unless massive blood transfusions are given.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Our resident medic has a couple of things to say about this object.

will begin to warm until it matches the body temperature of its host

This is called thermal conductivity.

Judging by the description, paragraph 2 and 3, the author does not consider amputation of the affected hand a severe physical trauma. Just a minor annoyance?

will filter … the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)

HIV integrates itself into T-cells, crashing the immunity system and causing AIDS. Also, HIV itself does not cause problems - the waste products of a secondary infection do. Turns out the bracelet cannot cure one's HIV without tearing apart all of his t-cells, but may be able to filter those waste products, improving the host's condition somehow.

will begin filtering components of the host's immune system … unnoticed without extensive blood analysis

Why the heck do we need extensive analysis? Just a plain clinical analysis which takes a minute to extract blood and another minute to analyze. It will show a decrease in leukocytes and the host will be hospitalized with leukopenia of unknown origin. Or, at least, thoroughly examined.

causing acute anemia and hemophilia

Hemophilia is a genetic, inherited disease. A clotting factor deficiency which only occurs in males. What the author was aiming for is probably thrombocytopenia.
